mentions.name: Pill Buddy Meds Tracker
mentions.description: A gamified pill and medication tracking app with a cute mascot. The mascot gets annoyed if the user hasn't taken their pills on time.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A gamified pill tracking app featuring a cute mascot: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pill-buddy-meds-tracker/id6742357512

The mascot gets annoyed if you haven’t taken your pills on time.
